title: CEI exp 2 Forge exp
description: Let Create Enchanting Industry Liquid Xp work with other mods
body:
This Datapack adds the ``forge: experience`` tag to the Liquid Experience in Create Enchantment Industry.

This Datapack currently only works for 1.20 and 1.20.1,

If you need a different version feel free to go into the code to change 1 number.[ How to do that (look for "Data pack formats")](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tutorials/Creating_a_data_pack#Pack_format)
